'''House Nalju''' was one of the six [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]], headed by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Nalju]]. It was on his estate that the [[Anti-Republic Liberation Front]] attempted to kidnap former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]]. The symbol for House Nalju were three overlapping white circles on a blue background.
